windowTitle: Serial integration stage 7 - W27 runnable Candidate: ship the buildx CLI plugin in the product image
scope: Close the source gap the roadmap names as 'the missing buildx in the product image': the product image shipped the docker CLI binary but not its buildx plugin, so the Build owner's `docker buildx build` would fail in the container. No provider, wallet, production or Instance action.
finding: Build.Runner invokes `docker buildx build` (services/build/internal/build/runner.go:511, exec.CommandContext(ctx, "docker", args...)). The runtime image copied only /usr/local/bin/docker from the pinned docker:27.5.1-cli stage; buildx is a separate CLI plugin at /usr/local/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx, which the docker CLI only discovers on that plugin path. The image therefore could not run an Agent OCI build.
implemented: Dockerfile: added `COPY --from=docker-cli /usr/local/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx /usr/local/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx` beside the docker binary copy.
tests/production/tke-control-plane-image.test.ts: added a Dockerfile assertion that the buildx plugin is copied from the docker-cli stage to the CLI plugin path.

commands: docker build -f <probe> : FROM the pinned docker:27.5.1-cli, COPY the docker binary and docker-buildx to the plugin path, RUN `docker buildx version`
verification.environment: local Docker Engine with the pinned docker:27.5.1-cli image already present; no registry push, provider or production access
cases: The buildx plugin binary exists at /usr/local/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx in docker:27.5.1-cli and reports `github.com/docker/buildx v0.20.1`.
After copying it to the same path, `docker buildx version` succeeds inside the image, proving the CLI resolves the plugin and the Agent build can start.
The three Dockerfile asset tests (three service binaries, buildx plugin, fabric contract ordering) pass.

notRun: No full product image build, no Agent OCI build against a real BuildKit/registry, no Candidate construction, no Instance deployment or production readback.
The repo-local OMA-layer naming drift (tools/tests that reference non-existent cmds) is outside this slice and unchanged.
claimBoundary: This receipt claims a source and image-asset change with a real local image probe: the product image now contains the buildx CLI plugin the Build owner needs. It does not claim a built Candidate, a real Agent build, deployment or production acceptance.
